summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 3 Career Tools features. All 3 P0 features are working correctly: 1) AI-powered resume improvement (summary + bullet points), 2) Email Templates tool with 5 email types, 3) Salary tools using centralized salaryBenchmarks.ts dataset. Backend API tests: 11/11 passed. Frontend UI tests: All features functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health returns 200 with healthy status
Backend: GET /api/career-tools/email-templates returns 5 templates (thank_you, follow_up, negotiation, decline, accept)
Backend: POST /api/career-tools/email-template generates thank_you email with subject and body
Backend: POST /api/career-tools/email-template returns 422 for missing required fields
Backend: POST /api/career-tools/improve-bullet improves bullet points with suggestions
Backend: POST /api/career-tools/improve-summary improves professional summary with word count
Frontend: Email Templates page loads with 5 email type buttons
Frontend: Email Templates generates email with subject, body, copy and regenerate buttons
Frontend: Resume Builder AI summary improvement shows suggestion with Accept/Dismiss
Frontend: Resume Builder AI bullet improvement shows suggestion with tips and Accept/Dismiss
Frontend: Salary Comparison displays assessment, chart, market range for Software Engineer in California
Frontend: Am I Underpaid displays gauge, assessment, market range for Data Analyst
Frontend: Career Tools hub shows Email Templates in Documents & Applications category
seed_data_creation: None required - tools use client-side data and AI APIs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 features fully tested and working: 1) Resume Builder has AI improve buttons for summary (data-testid='ai-improve-summary-btn') and bullets (data-testid='ai-improve-bullet-{idx}'). AI calls take 3-5 seconds. 2) Email Templates at /career-tools/email-templates has 5 types with data-testid selectors. 3) Salary tools use centralized salaryBenchmarks.ts with 90+ job titles across 15+ job families. All AI endpoints use EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from backend/.env.
